name: get_company_brsr_profile
description: Resolve a company to its latest profiled BRSR filing: Section A identity, product/service split (NIC codes + turnover shares), absolute revenue (INR crore), sector/industry classification, and markets served where filed. Look up by NSE symbol (preferred) or company name.

name.description: Company name substring when the symbol is unknown

name: find_brsr_peer_candidates
description: Peer candidates from the BRSR corpus sharing NIC divisions with the subject, each with deterministic 0-100 similarity scores (business: turnover-share-weighted NIC overlap; revenue: order-of-magnitude distance; market: filed markets-served comparison, null when filings lack the data). Returns candidates sorted by overall score. Copy these scores through unchanged.

max_candidates.description: Candidate pool size, 1-50; default 25. Bounds are clamped server-side — strict tool-use schemas reject minimum/maximum on integers.

name: emit_peer_set
description: Return the complete peer research result (subject profile + ranked peers with per-dimension scores, rationale and sources + methodology + caveats). Call exactly once when finished.
